main_measure.name: mean next-day unusual move of short cases (return minus coin drift, short direction)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day pooled

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, larger half of |forecast| minus smaller half

decided_by: Confirm rule met: mean unusual move above 0 with t >= 2 and the supporting check above 0.
reading: Cases are short-side bets (forecast deepening by >= 2 points from its least-short level since the last bet, reset at flat), the drift is the coin's mean daily return over all its windows, the t sums deviations per UTC day, the halves are the top and bottom floor(n/2) cases by |forecast| (middle case dropped if odd), the 30-day minimum gives 'not observable', and the profile is the recorded regime 'unknown'.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.004753 on the check folds against +0.005591 on every fold
